newsitem.title: UK: UK's Clarke cuts income tax rate by one pct.
newsitem.headline: UK's Clarke cuts income tax rate by one pct.

text.p: British finance minister Kenneth Clarke said on Tuesday he would cut the basic rate of income tax to 23 percent from 24 percent.

Clarke told parliament in a speech outlining his annual budget he was also increasing thresholds for paying personal tax. Without such increases, Clarke said he would have been able to reduce the basic rate of income tax by two percentage points.
Clarke said his budget contained tax cuts worth 2 billion pounds ($3.34 billion).
Earlier Clarke announced increases in indirect taxes, on petrol, air passenger duty, on tobacco products and on so-called alcoholic soft drinks. ($1=.5990 Pound)
